_about: FYM v98 (Version 1.2): the 38 'angled' mat photos with white corners that gate [89] listed (v97 warning). Each was LOOKED AT (contact sheets). replace = flattened photo (perspective warp when all 4 mat corners show; when the mat runs off the frame, the largest rectangle fully inside the mat at the photo's aspect). Colours re-measured from the new photo. not_angled = flat shots where white corners are the design / rounded corners / page curl / fringe (no fix needed; gate [89] skips them). skipped = could not be done cleanly. Applied by builder/fym_fix_oct25/v98_matflat.py; gate [89] fails if a fixed mat loses its flattened photo.
